messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up: recording dropped for ~30s during the demo, heard audio cut. Who's on AV?
Sam: On it, heading to the AV room. Switching encoders shortly.
Oliver: stream-health shows transient 502s at 15:02:11 - could be the proxy or encoder handshake.
infra-bot: ALERT: stream-proxy pod crashloop in prod-streaming (3/5 restarts). See /ops/incidents/789 for logs.
Sam: Restarting proxy now: `kubectl -n prod-streaming rollout restart deployment/stream-proxy` — swapping to encoder-b fallback.
Maya: Thanks. Can someone drop a marker where the gap was so Marketing can trim the recording?
Jen: Small agenda tweak request: move Roadmap up by ~20m and push Q&A to the final 20 minutes. @Evelyn ok with that?
Evelyn (CEO): Works for me. Move Platform roadmap earlier; we'll keep 20m at the end for live Q&A. Jen, please update the deck order.
Alex: Noted. For Q&A, can we prep answers on Dedicated SLA and pricing? Tara said she had bullets.
Tara: Adding bullets here: 1) 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated, 2) burst capacity options, 3) pricing tiers + overage handling. Also: will we demo Private deploy briefly?
Evelyn (CEO): Yes, add a 3-minute Private deploy slide. Sam/infra — confirm recording integrity and give us the exact gap timestamps we can attach to the edit request.
Sam: Recording stable now. Encoder switched. Gap logged: 15:02:10 — 15:02:45. I'll add a timestamp marker in the recording tool and push to the editing queue.
Maya: Perfect. Also need captions re-generated after edits so clips have subtitles for social.
Oliver: Kicking caption re-run job now: `jobs run caption-reprocess --recording 2026-06-01-1120`
infra-bot: INFO: caption-reprocess job queued (job id 4821).
Jen: :thumbsup: I'll update the agenda doc and ping Growth for highlight clip requests.
Maya: If anything else pops up, ping this thread. Otherwise ready to go live in ~3m.
